verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a Vulkan backend. The only AMD GPU support cited is via HIP (gh-9), which is the ROCm path the story seeks to avoid, so it does not count toward this story. The axis clearly applies to an inference engine, but nothing here shows a Vulkan path for AMD GPUs without ROCm.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
